Trace, implement and test: leetcode58 length of last word reverse traversal

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<string>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int lengthOfLastWord(string s) {
        s.erase(s.find_last_not_of(' ')+1);    // Trim尾部的空格
        s.erase(0, s.find_first_not_of(' '));  // Trim开头的空格
        int lastSpaceIndex = -1;
        int res;
        for (int i = s.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            if (s[i] == ' ')
            {
                lastSpaceIndex = i;
                res = s.size() - 1 - (i+1) + 1;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (lastSpaceIndex == -1) return s.size();
        return res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    string str = "   fly me   to   the moon  ";   
    auto res = sol.lengthOfLastWord(str);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
